cohort: Pregnant women and their children from three cohorts based on antipsychotic use
finding: Antipsychotic treatment during pregnancy carries limited risks of adverse pregnancy and birth outcomes after adjusting for health and lifestyle factors.
mod_finding: Caesarean section was initially more common in the group receiving antipsychotics during pregnancy, but the difference was non-significant after adjusting for health and lifestyle factors.
